sources.model: Copernicus Marine global analysis and forecast (GLOBAL_ANALYSISFORECAST_PHY_001_024), run 20261105, daily means; each 0.5 deg cell the mean of the native points inside it, levels interpolated linearly to the app depths.
sources.bathymetry: ETOPO1 via upwell.pfeg.noaa.gov ERDDAP (etopo180), sampled every 0.1 deg

citations.text: E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information: Global Ocean Physics Analysis and Forecast (GLOBAL_ANALYSISFORECAST_PHY_001_024), daily means, doi:10.48670/moi-00016. Lellouche, J.-M. et al., Mercator Ocean International.

Amante, C. and B. W. Eakins (2009), ETOPO1 1 Arc-Minute Global Relief Model: Procedures, Data Sources and Analysis, NOAA Technical Memorandum NESDIS NGDC-24, doi:10.7289/V5C8276M. (ETOPO1 is superseded by ETOPO 2022.)
